_comment: Data quality exceptions. Phase 11. Already referenced by api-dashboard-summary's getDataQualityExceptionCount() since Phase 4 but not formally schema'd until now. Populated by the scanForExceptions() service (functions/shared/services/data-quality-service.ts), which runs the nine named pure rules in functions/shared/pure/data-quality-rules.ts against live candidate records and syncs this table: opens a new row per newly-detected exception, resolves (never deletes) rows for exceptions no longer detected. Intended to run on a Cron schedule (Phase 13) as well as on-demand.
